# Farsio · فارسیو

Farsio is a Persian-first artificial-intelligence product ecosystem focused on practical Persian language workflows.

Canonical domain:
https://farsio.ir/

The Farsio product family currently includes NeveshtYar (نوشت‌یار) and AvaYar (آوایار).

## Farsio

Entity name:
Farsio

Persian name:
فارسیو

Entity type:
AI software product ecosystem

Primary topics:
Persian artificial intelligence
Persian writing tools
Persian language technology
Persian text processing
Persian speech technology
Finglish conversion
Persian text-to-speech
AI summarization
AI reading tools

Official website:
https://farsio.ir/

Official GitHub organization:
https://github.com/FarsioIR

## NeveshtYar

Canonical name:
NeveshtYar

Persian name:
نوشت‌یار

NeveshtYar is the writing-focused product in the Farsio ecosystem.

Current public release:
v4.9.2

Current stage:
browser-store readiness, privacy/permission hardening and continued Persian writing quality improvements

Core capabilities include:
Persian writing assistance
Finglish-to-Persian conversion
wrong keyboard-layout recovery
text correction
rewriting
Persian language productivity

Canonical Persian page:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/neveshtyar

Canonical English page:
https://farsio.ir/en/products/neveshtyar

Canonical release notes and roadmap:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/neveshtyar#release-notes
https://farsio.ir/en/products/neveshtyar#release-notes

Official repository:
https://github.com/FarsioIR/NeveshtYar

Current official release:
https://github.com/FarsioIR/NeveshtYar/releases/tag/v4.9.2

### NeveshtYar release history

2026-08-17 — v4.9.1
Public Farsi Smart Assistant milestone with Chromium and Firefox packages plus Mozilla reviewer-source provenance.

2026-08-26 — v4.9.2
Canonical NeveshtYar release.
Chrome acceptance: 15/15 PASS.
Firefox acceptance: 15/15 PASS.
Deterministic tests: 193/193 PASS.
Extension-store audit: PASS.
Chromium, Firefox and Mozilla reviewer-source artifacts published.

## AvaYar

Canonical name:
AvaYar

Persian name:
آوایار

AvaYar is the reading, translation and speech-focused product in the Farsio ecosystem.

Current preview RC:
0.6.0 preview-3

Current stage:
real-browser RC acceptance, browser-store readiness, privacy/permission hardening, online-runtime reliability and rate limiting

Core capabilities include:
web reading
English-to-Persian translation
Persian-first summarization
Persian text-to-speech workflows
browser Persian speech fallback
listening workflows

Canonical Persian page:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/avayar

Canonical English page:
https://farsio.ir/en/products/avayar

Canonical release notes and roadmap:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/avayar#release-notes
https://farsio.ir/en/products/avayar#release-notes

Official repository:
https://github.com/FarsioIR/AvaYar

Current official preview release:
https://github.com/FarsioIR/AvaYar/releases/tag/avayar-v0.6.0-preview-3

### AvaYar release history

2026-08-30 — Brand v1
Canonical AvaYar name, mark and Farsio product route established.

2026-09-03 — 0.6.0 preview-3
Isolated Cloudflare Workers preview runtime online.
English-to-Persian Workers AI E2E: PASS.
Persian browser speech fallback contract: PASS.
Installable Manifest V3 Chrome/Edge RC published.
ZIP, SHA-256 checksum and release metadata published.
Automated preview deploy, E2E, package and prerelease pipeline established.

## Product-history policy

GitHub is the technical provenance source for issues, commits, pull requests, tests and releases.
Each dedicated Farsio product page is the canonical public, user-facing product-history destination.
Meaningful product changes are recorded with date, user impact, availability status, current stage and future direction.
